items.title: Gene Bertoncini interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: Johnny would give me a lesson.

ctx.x: A children’s hour. Every Sunday morning. Once in a while my brother and I would get asked to play and accompany some children — not that I wasn’t — and it was great. And I wandered next door one day and I saw this great guitar playing in a studio. This was the NBC studios. I walked up to him with my little cowboy hat on and I said I’d like to play for him. Well he asked me — well he asked me to play. It was Johnny Smith. And I played my version of “Honeysuckle Rose” and then after that whenever I did a show I…
